cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I texted that I'd lost my job. You replied, 'What's for dinner?'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought something normal would help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Making your dinner? Can you see why I felt like the cook?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant we could go out. I'll book somewhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. Before you book, can you see why I heard a chore? I needed you to ask how I was.
